scripts.wasm:build: command -v wasm-pack >/dev/null 2>&1 && cd rust/openchaos_wasm && PATH="$HOME/.rustup/toolchains/stable-$(rustc -vV | grep host | cut -d' ' -f2)/bin:$PATH" wasm-pack build --target bundler --out-dir ../../src/wasm/pkg || echo 'wasm-pack not found, using pre-built WASM files'
scripts.wasm:dev: cd rust/openchaos_wasm && cargo watch -s 'wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir ../../src/wasm/pkg'
